intuition.title: Study context: Synthesis versus measurement
intuition.text: The gel preparation/decomposition gives the source nanocrystalline ZnO. Empty-cell cleaning, high-vacuum conditioning and hot vaporization belong to analysis; they do not supply additional growth schedules.

intuition.title: Study context: Aging interpretation
intuition.text: The authors interpret nanocr1 as metastable and nanocr2 as aged material with vaporization behavior closer to microcrystalline ZnO. No new particle size or storage atmosphere is reported.

intuition.title: Study context: Formal ion ratios
intuition.text: The Zn+/O2+ signals cannot determine vapor molar composition because scattered oxygen gives uncontrolled background. The table ratio remains an instrumental observation.
intuition.source_locator: Main PDF p. 2, Oxygen background and Table 2

intuition.title: Study context: Unresolved pressure scale
intuition.text: Table 3 coefficient rows are preserved without guessed powers of ten. The source pressure fits/plot and upper-limit table are available separately, without numerically repairing the table.

bindings.source_locator: Main PDF p. 1, Experimental, Knudsen cell and repeat measurement
bindings.caption: Before loading, hold empty cell at 1550 K for 6 h directly in mass spectrometer to remove impurities. This is apparatus cleaning, not ZnO heating or synthesis. Geometry is original conceptual equipment, not measured source apparatus.

bindings.source_locator: Main PDF p. 1, Experimental, Knudsen cell and repeat measurement
bindings.caption: Load the source specimen. Nanocrystalline loading is 130–150 mg; no microcrystalline loading mass is reported. Cell-hole/cross-section area ratio is 1:700. Geometry is original conceptual equipment, not measured source apparatus.

bindings.source_locator: Main PDF p. 1, Experimental, Knudsen cell and repeat measurement
bindings.caption: Hold the loaded cell at 450 K for 4 h under high vacuum. Monitor H2O and CO removal; initial measurement H2O+ and CO+ signals do not exceed 40–50 mV. Numerical vacuum pressure is unknown. Geometry is original conceptual equipment, not measured source apparatus.

bindings.source_locator: Main PDF p. 1–2, Experimental and Table 1
bindings.caption: Use MI-1201 mass spectrometer and platinum Knudsen cell. Table 1 uses 40 V ionization and 2.8 kV accelerating voltage. The study overall range 450–1446 K is analytical, not a synthesis ramp. Oxygen background prevents quantitative Zn/O2 vapor ratio determination. Geometry is original conceptual equipment, not measured source apparatus.

general_background.title: Thermodynamics and kinetics
general_background.summary: Thermodynamics describes which states are energetically favoured, while kinetics governs how quickly a system can move between them. A change can be favourable yet proceed slowly when an activation barrier or limited transport restricts the pathway.
general_background.label: General background, not the authors' interpretation
